harness: three short internal straight-through cables; all connections made unpowered, no hot-plug

power_contract.A_input: regulated 5 V only, regardless of the upstream B supply
power_contract.upstream_variants_status: platform requirement; not a claim that current B v0.5 supports all variants
power_contract.current_B_variant: temperature 24 V / 100 W; 12 V core exploration does not qualify board; 5 V variant not designed
power_contract.conversion_owner: B or one dedicated external 5 V source; never raw 12/24 V on A
power_contract.external_A_source_rule: Replace the B POWER cable with one protected 5 V source; do not backfeed B/J1 or parallel sources
power_contract.partial_powering: not qualified; connect I2C/CTRL only with both logics supplied; no hot-plug
power_contract.usb: No simultaneous ordinary USB cable and external 5 V; see manufacturing/power_and_usb_review.md
